stem:
Mehak stirs baking soda into a beaker of water at about 20 °C. Some baking soda remains undissolved at the bottom. She heats the mixture to about 50 °C while stirring.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Heating while stirring can make the undissolved baking soda dissolve.
At about 50 °C more baking soda can dissolve in the water than at about 20 °C.
Heating turns the undissolved baking soda into a new compound that cannot dissolve.

teacher.key_rationale: In the baking soda and water activity, heating from about 20 °C to 50 °C while stirring dissolves undissolved baking soda and allows more to dissolve. Heating does not turn it into an undissolvable new compound here.
